message: Secret baked into ENV in the image layer
fix: Pass secrets at runtime or use BuildKit secret mounts
fail:
FROM node:18
ENV DB_PASSWORD=hunter2
CMD ["node","index.js"]
pass:
FROM node:18
ENV NODE_ENV=production
CMD ["node","index.js"]

message: Secret passed as a --build-arg (persists in image history)
fix: Use BuildKit --secret mounts instead of build args
fail:
FROM node:18
RUN npm ci --build-arg NODE_AUTH_TOKEN=${NPM_TOKEN}
pass:
FROM node:18
RUN npm ci --build-arg TARGET=builder

message: Docker daemon configured to allow an insecure registry
fix: Serve the registry over TLS and remove the insecure-registry flag
fail:
FROM docker:24
RUN printf '{"insecure-registries":["registry.local"]}' > /etc/docker/daemon.json
pass:
FROM docker:24
RUN printf '{"registry-mirrors":["https://mirror.local"]}' > /etc/docker/daemon.json

message: apt installs packages without authentication
fix: Remove --allow-unauthenticated and verify repository signatures
fail:
FROM debian:12
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --allow-unauthenticated foo
pass:
FROM debian:12
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends foo

message: pip --trusted-host disables TLS verification for the index
fix: Trust the internal CA instead of passing --trusted-host
fail:
FROM python:3.11
RUN pip install --trusted-host pypi.internal flask
pass:
FROM python:3.11
RUN pip install flask

message: yum repository configured with gpgcheck=0
fix: Enable gpgcheck=1 and import the repository signing key
fail:
FROM rockylinux:9
RUN printf '[app]
name=app
gpgcheck=0
' > /etc/yum.repos.d/app.repo
pass:
FROM rockylinux:9
RUN printf '[app]
name=app
gpgcheck=1
' > /etc/yum.repos.d/app.repo

message: yum install skips signature verification
fix: Remove --nogpgcheck so packages are verified
fail:
FROM rockylinux:9
RUN yum install -y --nogpgcheck foo
pass:
FROM rockylinux:9
RUN yum install -y foo

message: Image exposes a cleartext/legacy service port (FTP/telnet/RDP)
fix: Remove the EXPOSE line or replace the service with a TLS equivalent
fail:
FROM alpine:3.18
EXPOSE 21
pass:
FROM alpine:3.18
EXPOSE 8080

message: git clone fetches source over cleartext http
fix: Clone over https or ssh
fail:
FROM alpine:3.18
RUN git clone http://example.com/repo.git /src
pass:
FROM alpine:3.18
RUN git clone https://example.com/repo.git /src

message: wget downloads a dependency over cleartext http
fix: Download over https and verify a checksum or signature
fail:
FROM alpine:3.18
RUN wget http://example.com/pkg.tar.gz -O /pkg.tar.gz
pass:
FROM alpine:3.18
RUN wget https://example.com/pkg.tar.gz -O /pkg.tar.gz

message: curl downloads over cleartext http
fix: Download over https and verify a checksum or signature
fail:
FROM alpine:3.18
RUN curl http://example.com/pkg.tar.gz -o /pkg.tar.gz
pass:
FROM alpine:3.18
RUN curl https://example.com/pkg.tar.gz -o /pkg.tar.gz

message: apt is allowed to downgrade packages during the build
fix: Remove --allow-downgrades to prevent version rollback attacks
fail:
FROM debian:12
RUN apt-get install -y --allow-downgrades libssl=1.0.0
pass:
FROM debian:12
RUN apt-get install -y libssl

message: npm TLS certificate verification disabled during the build
fix: Remove the strict-ssl override and fix the certificate trust instead
fail:
FROM node:18
RUN npm install --strict-ssl=false express
pass:
FROM node:18
RUN npm install express

message: Obsolete SSL/TLS protocol enabled
fix: Use SecurityProtocolType.Tls12 or newer only

message: LDAP search filter built from request input (LDAP injection)
fix: Escape filter characters or use a parameterized DirectorySearcher filter

message: XML reader processes DTDs (XXE risk)
fix: Set DtdProcessing = DtdProcessing.Ignore or ProhibitDtd = true

message: XPath expression built from request input (XPath injection)
fix: Use a parameterized XPath or escape the value

message: Insecure .NET binary formatter used
fix: Use System.Text.Json with explicit types instead of Binary/Soap/LosFormatter

message: Regex built from request input (ReDoS via catastrophic backtracking)
fix: Constrain the pattern, cap input length, or use a linear-time engine

message: Database password embedded in source code
fix: Load the connection string from a secret store or configuration

message: PBKDF2 iteration count below 10000
fix: Use at least 600000 iterations (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256)

message: Cryptographic bytes (key/IV/salt) decoded from a literal
fix: Generate or load key material at runtime

message: File path for a write built from request input
fix: Map the name to a fixed directory and reject '..' components

message: CORS policy allows every origin
fix: Allow only the exact origins that may call this API

message: JWT signing key hard-coded in source
fix: Load the signing key from the environment or a KMS

message: Server certificate validation callback accepts every certificate
fix: Validate the certificate chain instead of returning true

message: Uploaded file saved without content validation
fix: Validate type/size, randomize the name, and store outside the web root

message: Untrusted request data written straight to logs (log injection)
fix: Sanitize or structure-log the value instead of interpolating raw input

message: WebClient download URL comes from request input (SSRF)
fix: Allowlist destination hosts or map the parameter to known endpoints

message: EF raw SQL built by concatenation (SQL injection)
fix: Use FromSqlInterpolated/ExecuteSqlInterpolated with parameters

message: Triple DES is used (deprecated, 64-bit block)
fix: Use AES-GCM (AES.Create) for data at rest
